Extract Component Effects from MID Models

Source: R/methods_mid.R
coef.mid.Rd

coef() methods for extracting the fitted intercept and component effect tables from a "mid" (or "midrib") object.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mid'
coef(object, terms = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

a fitted "mid" (or "midrib") object.

terms

an optional character vector, formula, or terms object specifying a subset of terms (and intercept) to extract. Defaults to all terms in object.

...

further arguments passed to or from other methods.

Value

A named list containing the intercept (if included in terms) and data frames of component effects (excluding .density) for each matched term.

See also

interpret, predict.mid

Examples

data(airquality, package = "datasets")
mid <- interpret(Ozone ~ Wind * Temp, airquality, lambda = .5)
#> 'model' not passed: response variable in 'data' is used
coef(mid, terms = c("Wind", "Wind:Temp"))
